git.status_note: lines for the running v0.3 author session's paths are filtered out

latency.method: batch 1: 50 warm-up then median of 1,000 calls; batch 1024: 10 warm-up then median of 200 calls; forward + argmax under no_grad; Python policies: mean per-window over 1,024 windows

notes: val is reference only: Phase C early-stopped on val, and Phase B's 200 disclosed windows are val windows
dev-majority prior equals always-PRODUCTIVE when the dev majority is PRODUCTIVE
columns without a reference policy (Phase C, rules, priors) have no H2 fidelity

definitions.bootstrap: pairs resampled with replacement, 10000 resamples, seed 20261104
definitions.directional: pred(a) in {PRODUCTIVE, RECOVERY} and pred(b) in {STALLED, OSCILLATING}
definitions.endpoint_rate: consistent contrast endpoints / gate-passing contrast endpoints (pooled)
definitions.pairs_all: fraction of pairs consistent at every gate-passing contrast endpoint
definitions.pairs_any: fraction of pairs consistent at at least one gate-passing contrast endpoint
definitions.strict: pred(a) == oracle label of a and pred(b) == oracle label of b
definitions.unit: contrast endpoint: a window endpoint present in both branches where a's label is benign and b's is the degenerate label (synth.counterfactual.INTENDED)

gate.definition: agreement = (rejected & label INSUFFICIENT_INSTRUMENTATION) + (passed & other label), over all windows

definitions.bayes_accuracy: windows whose label equals their group's majority label / windows in the population
definitions.bayes_macro_f1: mean per-class F1 of the majority-label predictor over canonical classes with support > 0; precision is 0 for a class never predicted
definitions.collision_group: a group whose windows carry more than one distinct scored label
definitions.collision_rate: scored windows lying in a collision group / scored windows in the population (per class, per family, overall)
definitions.cross_split: a vector is shared when the same input-vector bytes occur in windows of two or more splits
definitions.group_key: exact bytes of the float32 (120,) input vector; group id = sha256 of those bytes
definitions.majority_label: most frequent scored label in a group; ties broken by canonical class order (lowest index wins)
definitions.population: windows that pass the runtime gate and carry a scored oracle label

gate.definition: agreement = (rejected & label INSUFFICIENT_INSTRUMENTATION) + (passed & other label), over all windows

bootstrap.shared_draws: every column of a split uses the same resampled sessions
